description: This file generates and populates dummy data for a banking application, including users, accounts, cards, transfers, messages, and statistics, using faker for data generation and mongoose for database interactions.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with default fake data and saves it to the database.

methods.name: createControlledUser
methods.description: Creates a specific user with a fixed email and saves it to the database.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a given user with random data.

methods.name: createCard
methods.description: Creates a new card for a user and account with random data.

methods.name: createTransfer
methods.description: Creates a transfer record for a user and source account with random data.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message for a user with random content.

methods.name: createStats
methods.description: Creates statistical data for an account with random income and expenses.

methods.name: generateData
methods.description: Generates multiple accounts, cards, transfers, stats, and messages for a user.
